{{Quote|Es'Loma screamed and fell over the edge of the platform. We ran to see what was going on and they hit us from behind. They took the box, and killed the Jedi.|Wojarra, describing the theft of the Mandalorian iron box by the Believers|<ref name="CD" />}}
'''Es'Loma''' was a [[Tarasin]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Wyrd]], a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Es'Loma ventured to the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and assisted the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]] in stealing a [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box that the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] thought contained a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]]. She accompanied the Believers back to their [[Coruscant Believers base|secret base]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant undercity]] and was attacked and defeated there by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-allied [[Heroes of Cularin|agents]] sent to recover the stolen box.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We landed and Es'Loma got out and walked to the edge of the platform.|Wojarra|<ref name="CD" />}}
Es'Loma was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tarasin]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a member of the [[Wyrd]], a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-wielding [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CD" /> Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is placed in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the events of ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' can be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> the [[Pulas]], a powerful and ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], was discovered on the planet [[Almas]] by a team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] researchers. The [[Believers]],<ref name="CD" /> a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-worshipping [[Sith cult|cult]]<ref name="BOTB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref> that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], sought steal the artifact and Es'loma mastermined a scheme to help the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] seize the relic from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="CD" />

To prevent the Pulas from falling into the clutches of the Believers, the Jedi arranged for the artifact to be transported to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for safekeeping. The Jedi assembled a small [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to convey the artifact; each [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the fleet was to carry a [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box to Coruscant, of which one box contained the Pulas and the remainder were decoys. Es'Loma enlisted with the crew of a vessel in the armada that the Believers suspected was carrying the Pulas, joining the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Wojarra]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CD" /> [[Force Adept]]s<ref name="TRW">{{LivingForce|Eye of the Sun: The Resistance Within}}</ref> [[San Herrera]] and [[Nia Reston]] aboard the ship. The group collected their assigned box from the [[Almas Academy]] [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] [[Jedi academy|institution]] on Almas and departed for Coruscant. Es'Loma planned to help the Believers steal the relic once the ship arrived on Coruscant and she kept her true intentions and her affiliation with the Wyrd secret from the rest of the crew. In truth, the Mandalorian iron box aboard the ship was one of the decoys and contained not the Pulas but a fragment of the dark side-imbued [[City/Legends|city]] [[Conkesta]].<ref name="CD" />

When the Jedi fleet reached Coruscant, Es'Loma's ship docked on a [[Hangar/Legends|landing platform]] and she and the rest of the crew were greeted by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nysis Belzara]], who had come to escort them to a safe house. To cause a diversion, as part of a pre-arranged plan Es'Loma deliberately fell off edge of the platform and was caught by a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] waiting below. While Belzara and Es'Loma's fellow crew members were distracted by the Tarasin witch's feigned plight, a team of Believer thugs assaulted the landing platform and stole the Mandalorian iron box.<ref name="CD" />

Afterward, the Believers retreated back to their [[Coruscant Believers base|secret base]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant undercity]] with their prize. Es'Loma joined the cultists at the hideout and went to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]] in an alcove near the entrance to the facility.<ref name="CD" />

{{RPG|''[[Coruscani Dawn]]''}}
A group of Jedi-affiliated [[Heroes of Cularin|agents]] arrived at the Believer base in hot pursuit of the stolen box. Es'Loma awoke and attacked the Jedi agents, using the Force to conceal her presence while she struck at them. However, she and the Believers were defeated; the Mandalorian iron box was recovered by agents and subsequently escorted to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]],<ref name="CD" /> the headquarters of the Jedi Order.<ref name="Databank">{{DB|location|jeditemple|Jedi Temple}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Es'Loma was a Tarasin. No one could survive that fall. She was so excited about seeing Coruscant too&hellip;|Wojarra|<ref name="CD" />}}
Es'Loma was an unpleasant individual and was adept at deception, as was demonstrated by the plan that she devised to steal the Pulas whereby she infiltrated the crew of the vessel suspected of transporting the relic. In combat situations, she had a distaste for partaking in fights where her opponents were significantly outmatched. When traveling with Herrera, Reston and Wojarra to Coruscant, Es'Loma gave the impression that she was excited to see the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-covered world]].<ref name="CD" />

==Powers and abilities==
Es'Loma was experienced in the use of the Force to [[Force sense|sense]] things, [[Mind trick/Legends|affect the minds]] of others, [[Telekinesis/Legends|move objects]]. She was also familiar with the [[Force power/Legends|powers]] [[Drain Knowledge]], [[Hatred]], [[Sense Force|See Force]] and [[Force storm (weather)|Summon Storm]]. In addition, Es'Loma was also a formidable fighter and a skilled climber.<ref name="CD" />

==Equipment==
During her attempted theft of the Pulas, Es'Loma carried a hold-out [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]] and she wore street [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]].<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Es'Loma appeared in ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure by [[Morrie Mullins]] that was released in [[2002]] as part of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign.<ref name="CD" />

In ''Coruscani Dawn'', the players [[Roleplaying game|role-play]] as the Jedi-allied agents sent to recover the stolen Mandalorian iron box. The actions and decisions of the players affect the outcomes of their encounter with Es'Loma and the Believers at the secret undercity base. If the player characters apprehend a Believer guard posted to watch the entrance to the secret undercity base, Es'Loma is asleep and off-guard when the players arrive at the hideout. If the players fail to apprehend the guard, Es'Loma receives advance warning that the players are coming and sets an ambush by climbing on the ceiling and leaping down onto the player characters when they enter the base. If the player characters are significantly outmatched by Es'Loma and the Believers, the Tarasin witch crawls onto the ceiling and leaves the hideout in disgust at the poor odds. It is also possible for Es'Loma to be incapacitated or [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the fight. If Es'Loma is immobilized, the Believers thugs start to flee the base.<ref name="CD" />
